title: docs(AGENTS.md): the wrong-cwd false-green passage cites app-shell as 281 test files; it is ~633–649 — a stale number inside the evidence for the trap it teaches
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`) on behalf of the objectui#8379 dev, who measured it while landing PR #8389 and deliberately left the filing judgement to the PM — on the grounds that `AGENTS.md` is a governed surface (any fix stops in draft for a human anyway) and a bare number correction may not be worth a card. ⛔ Not claimed.

**It is worth one, narrowly:** the number is not decoration, it is the *evidence* inside the passage that teaches the wrong-cwd false-green trap — the passage agent briefs quote when telling a dev why `Test Files 22 passed (22)` is the console's suite and not app-shell's. A stale figure there weakens the lesson exactly where the reader is being asked to trust a count.

## Measured

`AGENTS.md:186`, in the trap-one passage:

```
成功。于是跑的是 `@object-ui/console` 的 22 个文件、报 `Test Files 22 passed (22)`,而本包
(app-shell 有 281 个)一个都没跑。**没有 "0 tests matched" 信号** —— 计数是 22 不是 0,
```

Against today's tree:

| source | app-shell test files |
|---|--:|
| `AGENTS.md:186` | **281** |
| this seat, `find packages/app-shell/src -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx'` | **633** |
| the runner, PR #8389's suite run (`vitest run packages/app-shell/`) | **649 files / 6256 tests** |

The two live readings differ from each other for the ordinary reason (the runner's collection is not identical to a `find` over two extensions under `src/`); both are ~2.3× the documented figure.

⚠️ Recording a measurement error of this seat's own, because it is the same class the passage is about: the first grep for this used the pattern `281 files` / `281 个文件` and returned **nothing**, which read as "the dev's claim does not reproduce". The passage is in Chinese and spells it `281 个`. The lit control (`app-shell` = 2 hits in the file) is what showed the file was being read at all and that the zero was the pattern's fault, not the claim's.

## Scope

⛔ **The mechanism the passage teaches is unaffected and the argument still holds** — this is documentation drift, not a defect. The fix is one number, and whoever takes it should re-derive it rather than copying either figure above, and say which instrument they used, since the two disagree by 16.

`AGENTS.md` is a **governed surface**, so the change routes through the governed queue and stops for a human regardless.

## Related

objectui#8379 / PR #8389 (where it was measured) · objectui#3378 (the guard that refuses the `--filter … exec vitest` spelling) · the same passage is the source of the "`cd packages/X && pnpm exec vitest` silently runs `apps/console`'s files" warning carried in every dispatch brief this session

## Dedup

⚠️ **Not run, declared rather than hidden.** The reporting dev did not search (it left the filing call to the PM), and this seat has not run a targeted search for this specific line either. **No dedup claim is made.** Suggested query for a triager: `AGENTS.md app-shell test file count stale 281`.
